meta.name: capital-structure-and-covenants
meta.description: Decides how the business is financed and what that financing then requires of it — debt versus equity, weighted average cost of capital as a hurdle rate, how much leverage cash flow can carry, and the financial, affirmative and negative covenants, definitions, test dates and cure rights that come attached. Use this to evaluate a financing option, set an investment hurdle, check whether a planned decision will trip a covenant, or work out what a lender can do when one breaks.

copy.tagline: 判断融资方案是否可行并检验债务契约风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在融资前需要评估资本结构与契约约束
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate financing options and check covenant risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess capital structure and covenants before financing

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你把融资决策拆成具体约束:计算加权平均资本成本作投资门槛,按最差情况而不是乐观计划判断杠杆是否扛得住,并逐条核查财务、肯定性、否定性契约及其定义、测试日和补救权。遇到可能违约时,它会提醒你在测试日前去找贷款方协商。
howto.when: 当你评估融资选项、设定投资门槛、或解决融资契约相关问题时触发,例如核查某个计划决策会不会触发契约、违约后贷款方可以做什么。

say.text: 帮我把债务和权益的实际成本加权,算出投资门槛比率。
say.note: 得到加权平均资本成本,用于投资决策门槛。

say.text: 用最差现金流情形测算,我们能承受的负债上限是多少?
say.note: 它会用下行情景和现金流稳定性给出杠杆空间。

say.text: 如果我们收购一家公司,会不会触发现有贷款契约里的限制?
say.note: Claude 会对照定义和测试日,推演是否会违约。

howto.what_en: Claude will evaluate financing choices by computing WACC as the hurdle, sizing leverage to the downside case, reviewing financial/affirmative/negative covenants plus definitions, test dates and cure rights, and advising early lender discussion if a breach looms.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you evaluate a financing option, set an investment hurdle, or work through covenant-related questions such as a trip risk or lender remedies after a breach.

say_en.text: What is our WACC using actual debt and equity proportions?
Test the maximum debt we can carry in our worst-case operating scenario.
If we buy that company, will we trip any loan covenant?
